sample_evaluations.customer_text: @AmazonHelp I ordered item Order # 026-9925496-9968316 on the 17th Nov via Prime. It has still not arrived. Any ideas where it is??? Not happy!
sample_evaluations.reply: @AmazonHelp I’m sorry you haven’t received your order yet. Could you let me know the delivery date that was provided in your confirmation email? I’ll look into it and get back to you shortly.

scores.reason: The reply apologizes, asks for the delivery date, and promises to investigate—directly addressing the customer’s concern. It mirrors past responses, so it is well grounded and contains no false claims.

sample_evaluations.customer_text: @120474 can you tell us why we brought 2 @263821 tickets only to get an email saying there was a problem with our order 5 mins later?
sample_evaluations.reply: Hi there! I’m sorry to hear about the hiccup with your tickets. I’ll look into what caused the email notification and get back to you with an update as soon as possible. In the meantime, could you please confirm the order ID or the email address you used to place the order? That will help me locate the details quickly. Thanks for your patience!

scores.reason: The reply acknowledges the issue, offers to investigate, and requests key details, which is helpful and relevant. It follows the style of past responses but does not directly cite evidence, so grounding is moderate. No false claims are made, ensuring safety.
